description: Laser-scanned range image dataset from asphalt and concrete roadways for DCNN-based crack classification is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Wei Song, University of Alabama (ua.edu). In recent years, deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) has been extensively explored and applied for civil engineering applications such as roadway crack detection. Despite a certain success, several challenges in DCNN-based roadway crack detection are yet to be fully addressed. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: deep convolutional neural network, laser-scanned range image, roadway crack. Published 2020-02-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
